questions.question: Who and what are called to praise the LORD in Psalm 148?
options: Only the priests and the Levites, who minister continually at the altar
All creation, from the heavens, angels, sun and moon, to earth and its creatures
Only the kings of the whole earth, bowing down low before the great throne
Only the people of Israel, who are gathered together before the temple
questions.answer: All creation, from the heavens, angels, sun and moon, to earth and its creatures

questions.question: Why should they praise the LORD, according to the psalm?
options: Because he commanded and they were created; his name alone is exalted
Because he gave them the law and they obey it; his statutes are righteous
Because he chose Zion and dwells there; his glory fills the temple
Because he led them from Egypt; his right hand worked salvation
questions.answer: Because he commanded and they were created; his name alone is exalted

questions.question: The psalm calls sun, moon, and shining stars to praise the LORD.
Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise him in the _____ places!
Let them praise the name of the LORD! For he commanded and they were _____.
